approved_translation: Do not trust a mediator who benefits from your dispute; the crafty exploit division.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: One day a Wolf said to her mate, "A longing has come upon me to eat fresh fish." "I will go and get some for you," said he and he went down to the river. There he saw two Otters standing on the bank looking for fish. You live on land, not in the water." Then he told her of the quarrel of the Otters. "I took the fish as pay for settling their quarrel," said he.
